headline: K9 Unit holds off Stroud and Proud in a 2.7-point thriller

games.headline: K9 Unit holds off Stroud and Proud in a 2.7-point thriller
article: K9 Unit beat Stroud and Proud 142.20 to 139.50 in Week 3, a nail-biter decided by 2.70 points. It doesn't get much closer than that.

K9 Unit put up 142.20 this week, 23.9 over their projected 118.3 and the highest score in the league. Bijan Robinson carried them with 34.3 points, about a quarter of the team's total, 16.9 over his projection. Jordan Love (22.0) and Kenneth Walker III (20.3) were the other big contributors.

Stroud and Proud put up 139.50 this week, 25.3 over their projected 114.2 and the 2nd-highest score of the week. Tyler Shough led the way with 31.6, and Jaxon Smith-Njigba added 29.8. Stroud and Proud scored the 2nd-most points in the league this week and still lost. Brutal.
The letdown for Stroud and Proud was TreVeyon Henderson, who managed 3.4 on a 9.7 projection.
The letdown for K9 Unit was Omarion Hampton, who managed 5.6 on a 14.0 projection.

Here's the painful part for Stroud and Proud: starting Michael Wilson (20.4) instead of Chris Olave (15.2) and RJ Harvey (7.7) instead of TreVeyon Henderson (3.4) would have produced 149.00 points, enough to win.
K9 Unit could have scored even more by starting Kenyon Sadiq (20.0) instead of Mark Andrews (3.9) and Jameson Williams (6.9) instead of Omarion Hampton (5.6).
At quarterback, Tyler Shough (31.6) outdueled Jordan Love (22.0).
K9 Unit improves to 2-1 (2nd place). Stroud and Proud drops to 1-2 (6th).
Next week, K9 Unit faces The Canberra Mob (1-2), who are coming off a 37.8-point loss to I Call Gibbs.
Next week, Stroud and Proud faces Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup (1-2), who are coming off a 13.7-point loss to Ken.
